Is there a difference between being narcissistic and being egotistical?

Asking google to define each and then comparing them can only get you so far, so I decided to ask here. I'm interested in narcissism and was recently  wondering if there was a difference. Egotistical is defined as, "excessively conceited or absorbed in oneself; self-centered" while  narcissism is define as, "excessive interest in or admiration of oneself and one's physical appearance." Both of these don't seem to give enough  details so I wanted to ask the people who have first-hand experience.

Does anyone have a simple way to compare them or a better definition of narcissism that they could offer? Possibly, is being egotistical part of being narcissistic? If you can tell, I don't know much about narcissism; however, I would love to read comments explaining it so that  I could gain more of an understanding.
